story.title: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026
story.sum: UPS posted a PDF with new fuel surcharge tables for U.S. Ground Domestic, UPS Ground Saver and Domestic Air, effective November 2, 2026. The Ground table runs from 28.50% ($5.53–$5.80 diesel) to 31.50% ($6.79–$6.88), and the Air table runs from 31.50% ($4.06–$4.11 jet fuel) to 34.50% ($4.66–$4.71). The out-of-range anchor prices rose from $4.99 to $5.80 for Ground and from $3.01 to $3.56 for Air, which shows the table was reset. Also: UPS announces U.S. Ground, Ground Saver and Domestic Air fuel surcharge changes Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Shippers using UPS Ground, Ground Saver or the Domestic Air services get a different surcharge percentage for any given fuel price from Nov 2, 2026. The size of the change per shipment can't be calculated because the old percentage rows are not in the supplied text.

story.title: UPS announces 5.9% average rate increase and new surcharges effective Dec 21, 2026
story.sum: UPS added a package-rate notice effective December 21, 2026. Daily Rates for Ground, Air and International rise an average net 5.9%. Area Surcharge and zone ZIP lists change, the Additional Handling minimum billable weight goes from 40 to 50 lbs., and a new origin-ZIP surcharge is coming for Ground and Ground Saver. Fuel surcharges for Ground, Ground Saver and Air will also change on November 2, 2026. Also: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Nearly all U.S. small-parcel shippers on UPS Ground, Air or International face higher base rates. Shippers with remote-area or reclassified ZIPs, Additional Handling packages, or qualifying origin ZIPs may see further cost changes. Actual impact depends on each shipper's agreement.

story.title: UPS announces Dec 21, 2026 rate increase, 50 lb Additional Handling threshold, ZIP changes
story.sum: UPS's Important Updates now say that, effective December 21, 2026, Daily Rates for Ground, Air and International services rise an average net 5.9%. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight goes from 40 to 50 lbs., and the Area Surcharge and zone ZIP lists change. Also new: an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers (December 21, 2026 or later) and a fuel surcharge change effective November 2, 2026. Also: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Shippers using UPS Ground, Air or International face an average net 5.9% rate increase. Actual cost depends on each shipper's agreement and profile. Shippers in affected ZIPs may see different Area Surcharges or zones, and Ground/Ground Saver shippers sending from certain origin ZIPs may pay an extra per-package surcharge.
